name: Transport and browser protection headers
objective: Check whether the approved origin sets the browser protections a modern site is expected to send.
preconditions: The approved scope includes an HTTP or HTTPS origin
steps: Request the approved origin and capture the response headers.
Compare the headers against the protections a browser relies on: content-security-policy, x-content-type-options, x-frame-options, referrer-policy, and strict-transport-security.
Report a candidate when any of them is absent, naming the ones that are.
falsePositives: A gateway or CDN in front of the origin may add these headers before a browser sees them; check the edge, not only the origin.
An API endpoint that never renders in a browser is not made safer by browser protections, and reporting it as though it were inflates the finding.

finding.title: Missing browser protection headers
finding.summary: The approved origin answered without the browser protections a modern site is expected to send.
